serviceCards.title: Individual Therapy
serviceCards.tagline: The work that has to happen first.
serviceCards.description: Patterns, history, capacity, self-worth. For people who are competent almost everywhere else and stuck in one place.

serviceCards.title: Couples Therapy
serviceCards.tagline: For two people who still want this to work.
serviceCards.description: For couples who still want this to work and have run out of ways to say so. Structured, even-handed, and honest.

serviceCards.title: Before You Marry
serviceCards.tagline: Five sessions that will save you five years.
serviceCards.description: The conversations most couples never have until they are expensive. Money, family, faith, intimacy, and failure.

serviceCards.title: The Annual Review
serviceCards.tagline: A yearly check-up for a marriage that isn't broken.
serviceCards.description: Maintenance, not repair. One structured session a year to catch drift while it is still small enough to name.

serviceCards.title: The Intensive
serviceCards.description: For crisis, for people whose diaries do not permit weekly work, and for couples flying in to do this properly.

serviceCards.title: Diaspora Sessions
serviceCards.tagline: The marriage and the culture, both understood.
serviceCards.description: For Nigerians abroad who want someone who understands the marriage and the culture without needing it explained.

beliefs.title: Your relationship will only be as healthy as you are.
beliefs.body: This is not a slogan. It is the reason I will always start with you before I start with the marriage.

beliefs.title: Rupture is normal. Unrepaired rupture is fatal.
beliefs.body: Strong couples are not couples who never fight. They are couples who have a fast, practised way back. Repair is a skill, and it can be taught.

beliefs.title: Counselling is not court.
beliefs.body: I am not here to decide who is right. If you leave my room feeling you won, I have failed at my job.

beliefs.title: You don't find the right person. You become one.
beliefs.body: This is the hardest thing I say to singles, and the truest.

processSteps.title: A free conversation
processSteps.body: Fifteen minutes, no charge, no obligation, nothing on record. You describe what is happening. I tell you honestly whether I am the right person.

processSteps.title: Assessment
processSteps.body: The first paid session is an examination. Your history, your patterns, and what brought you here now rather than last year.

processSteps.title: The work
processSteps.body: Noticing what recurs, tracing where it was learned, and building something different — deliberately, and with practice.

processSteps.title: Review
processSteps.body: At session six we stop and look at it together. What has moved, what has not, and whether to continue.
